newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian blue chip shares fall again.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian blue chip shares fall again.

text.p: Blue chip share prices slid further on the Nigerian stock exchange on Monday amid a continuing bearish trend, dealers said.
However the stock exchange said that the all-share index closed up at 7974.38 from 7971.84 on Friday.
"People are not buying yet and large quantities of shares are on offer," one dealer said.
Cadbury fell to 31.69 naira, down 81 naira, while Nigerian Bottling Company dropped 50 kobo to 48.00 naira.
PZ Industries was at 22.60 naira and Lever Brothers was at 22.80 naira, with both conglomerates down by 20 kobo.
Oil marketers African Petroleum and Unipetrol ended respectively at 48.00 naira and 61.50 naira, losing 50 kobo apiece.
Recent big gainer AIICO Insurance dropped to 8.65 naira on Monday because of an adjustment for scrip. It closed at 17.30 naira last Friday.
Courier company Trans-nationwide express and beds manufacturer Vono were Monday's only gainers. Trans-nationwide added two kobo to 1.50 naira while Vono was one kobo stronger at 3.12 naira.
